from openai import OpenAI
import re

client = OpenAI()

JUDGE = ("Compare A vs B for question. Reply with one of: A_BETTER, B_BETTER, TIE.\n"
         "Q: {q}\nA: {a}\nB: {b}")

def judge(q: str, a: str, b: str) -> str:
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model="{{judge_model}}",
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": JUDGE.format(q=q, a=a, b=b)}],
    )
    out = r.choices[0].message.content
    m = re.search(r"(A_BETTER|B_BETTER|TIE)", out)
    return m.group(1) if m else "TIE"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(judge("2+2?", "4", "five"))
